description: Tabulated points used by the verification gate of decision D46 version 3: the gasoline rows of Table 7.1-2 and the worked example of the US EPA AP-42 chapter 7.1 (June 2026 edition). The edition fetched on 2026-10-29 tabulates three gasoline classes (RVP 13, 10, 7), not the eight classes named in the decision; the others (7.8, 8.3, 11.5, 13.5, 15) do not appear in it.
source: https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2026-08/c7s1_2026.pdf, Table 7.1-2 (page 7.1-102) and the example of Section 7.1.4 (page 7.1-212)
